name: frontend-skills
description: React/TypeScript frontend enforcement harness. 77 wired hooks across 80 scripts enforce patterns on every edit. 41 skills cover the full development lifecycle from TDD through CI-green PR. Session exit blocked while PR review threads remain unresolved. TypeScript escape hatches (any/Record<T,any>/type=unknown/double-cast) blocked at Edit time. tsconfig strictness weakening blocked. 5 agents, 5 routines. Opus 4.7 tuned. POSIX-friendly.

x-changelog.3.1.1: 2026-04-18 — Opus 4.7 effort downsized one tier in CLAUDE.md. Understand/Plan/Simplify/Verify: xhigh → high. Implement (TDD) + Review: max → xhigh. No `max` left in the table — 4.7 hits diminishing returns at max for most phases; xhigh reserved for the final gates.
x-changelog.3.1.0: 2026-04-17 — PR feedback completeness enforcement + TypeScript strictness hardening. New `pr-feedback-completeness-stop.sh` Stop hook blocks session exit while any non-bot, non-outdated review thread is unresolved or any reviewer's latest state is CHANGES_REQUESTED — no stones unturned before handing back to human. GraphQL isolated in `scripts/pr-unresolved-count.sh` wrapper (GitHub REST has no thread-level isResolved). New `ts-no-escape-hatches-check.sh` PostToolUse hook blocks `: any`, `any[]`, `Array<any>`, `Promise<any>`, `Record<string,any|unknown>`, `Record<any,...>`, `type X = any|unknown|never|{}`, `as unknown as T` double-cast, with `// allow: ts-escape` escape hatch. New `tsconfig-strict-check.sh` blocks weakening of `strict`, `noImplicitAny`, `strictNullChecks`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noImplicitOverride`, `strictFunctionTypes`. Lifecycle-stop gains adjacent-test fallback — tests on disk (prior session, worktree, __tests__/) now satisfy the coverage gate, fixing the worktree/multi-session false-flag. AI self-review cap bumped 2 → 3 rounds with explicit early-exit on APPROVED/empty-findings. Two new eval files (test-pr-feedback-enforcement 29/29, test-ts-strictness 34/34). Eval suite 1387/1387 green. test-hooks.sh set -e pipefail bug fixed.
x-changelog.2.5.0: 2026-04-17 — Consistency fix: converted 4 plugin commands (/commit-push, /commit-push-pr, /hook-audit, /frontend-skills-stats) to skills. Plugin commands show prefixed in slash autocomplete (/frontend-skills:commit-push) while skills show unprefixed (/tdd). Converting all user-facing entrypoints to skills gives uniform unprefixed display. `!`bash`` pre-context now runs as explicit Step 0 inside each skill. No behavior change for users — same slash name, same workflow.
x-changelog.2.4.0: 2026-04-17 — /write-a-skill audit: /go and /work skill descriptions corrected. /go removed broken 'Alias: /ship' (no /ship skill exists) and switched 'Use after' → 'Use when' per write-a-skill trigger rule. /work switched 'Use for' → 'Use when'. No functional change; audit compliance only.
x-changelog.2.3.0: 2026-04-17 — P0 resilience: defensive `_hook-lib.sh` source in all 43 PostToolUse hooks. If plugin cache corrupts (dangling symlink, missing file, bad install), hooks now warn ONCE per session via marker file and no-op cleanly instead of spamming N errors per Edit (one error per hook × every edit = unusable session). Eval sentinel (evals/test-hooks.sh) blocks regression to plain source pattern. New /go skill: composition for phases 4-6 (verify → self-review → simplify → commit-push-pr → monitor CI → fix → done). Chains self-reviewer, adversarial-reviewer, code-reviewer agents, /simplify, /commit-push-pr, /resolve-pr-feedback. New /work alias for /development-lifecycle. Development-lifecycle phases 4-6 now delegate to /go. Effort levels bumped to xhigh→xhigh→max→xhigh→xhigh→max for Opus 4.7 adaptive reasoning.
x-changelog.2.2.4: 2026-04-17 — 9 new hook events wired: SessionEnd (metrics aggregation moved from Stop — now runs once per session), PreCompact (snapshot state before compaction), PostToolUseFailure (categorized failure remediation), FileChanged (5 matchers: package.json/lockfiles, proto/graphql, biome/tsconfig/vitest configs, src/env.ts, skill-manifest.json auto-regen), WorktreeCreate (logs + spawn count warning for isolated-worktree agents). Eval overhaul: fixed set -e early-abort bug that hid 60 pre-existing failures; reconciled 44 stale tests to match refactored hook ownership (as-cast, react-compiler, biome-ignore, test-perf). 1321/1321 green. Extensions remain TypeScript-only (ts/tsx/mts/cts).
x-changelog.2.2.3: 2026-04-16 — Plugin load fix: removed explicit `hooks: ./hooks/hooks.json` from plugin.json. Standard path is auto-loaded by Claude Code, and the explicit reference caused a duplicate-load error in v2.2.2. No functional change; users on 2.2.2 should reinstall.
x-changelog.2.2.2: 2026-04-16 — Manifest codegen: single-source skill-manifest.json generates .claude/settings.json + hooks/hooks.json via scripts/generate-hook-configs.sh. Lefthook pre-push drift check. New tiers in _hook-lib.sh: hook_info (silent JSONL), hook_nudge (soft warn), hook_block_strict (no escape), hook_emit_diagnostic (LSP-style with range+fix). Portable ms-timing (bash 5+ EPOCHREALTIME, graceful fallback to SECONDS on macOS bash 3.2). metrics-summary-stop schema v2: perf_ms p50/p95 per hook, nudge/info/diagnostic counts. New /frontend-skills-stats command (analytics dashboard). New /extend-harness skill (maintainer guard rail). POSIX-friendly (no date +%s%N, portable timeout detection).
x-changelog.2.2.1: 2026-04-16 — P0 bugfix: dereferenced 35 symlinks in .claude/hooks/*.sh to real files. Plugin packager was resolving relative symlinks (../../shared/hook-lib.sh) to absolute paths at package time, creating dangling links in install cache. All PostToolUse hooks were failing silently at `source _hook-lib.sh` (line 3). Plugin users on <=2.2.0 must reinstall via /plugin install.
